subject.title: [Feature Request] Make command options clickable buttons in Feishu (e.g., /reasoning)

question: Should no-argument command-status replies such as `/reasoning` and `/verbose` emit shared typed command-action presentation for capable channels, or should this stay a Feishu-only/card-specific UX?
rationale: Current policy favors typed portable presentation actions and channel renderers over Feishu-only parsing of `Options:` text, but the exact product surface spans shared command replies and channel-native menu behavior.

options.title: Shared typed presentation
options.body: Emit typed command-action buttons from the shared command-status reply path and let capable channels such as Feishu render them natively while text-only channels keep fallback text.

options.title: Feishu-only card transform
options.body: Teach Feishu to transform recognized command-status option replies into cards, accepting a channel-specific parser and maintenance burden.

options.title: Native args-menu only
options.body: Rely on command registry `argsMenu` surfaces and leave no-argument status replies as text-only.

recommendation.title: Shared typed presentation
recommendation.body: Emit typed command-action buttons from the shared command-status reply path and let capable channels such as Feishu render them natively while text-only channels keep fallback text.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the typed presentation command-action contract that appears to be the cleanest implementation boundary for this choice.
